description: Angular component for a LED indicator widget in Thingsboard, handling device status checks, subscriptions, and visual updates.

classes.name: LedIndicatorComponent
classes.description: Angular component for a LED indicator widget, managing device status polling, subscriptions, and visual state.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the component, sets up DOM references, resize observer, and calls init().

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up subscriptions, timers, and disconnects resize observer.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes settings, colors, subscriptions, and device status checks based on widget configuration.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Adjusts LED size and font sizes based on container dimensions.

methods.name: setFontSize
methods.description: Calculates and sets font size for text elements to fit within max width.

methods.name: measureTextWidth
methods.description: Measures the width of text with a given font size.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Displays error message and adjusts font size accordingly.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Updates the LED state and color based on boolean value.

methods.name: updateColor
methods.description: Updates the LED's background color and shadow based on current value.

methods.name: rpcCheckStatus
methods.description: Performs a remote procedure call to check device status and manages polling.

methods.name: subscribeForValue
methods.description: Creates a subscription to device attribute or timeseries data.

methods.name: onDataUpdated
methods.description: Handles incoming data updates, parses value, and updates LED state.
